source: All original example data below is copied complete from exact historical records. Earlier contradictory outcomes remain historical, not current requirements.

completeWorkedCases: Capturing a fire Strike grants fire resistance through next end; adapting it permits paid bounded releases within two regular-start intervals.
Copying a harmless warning reveals no damage type and grants no invented resistance.
Observe rank 4 damage: half-rankq 2 Strike may be captured if your real route can learn rank 2, then costs 3 RP next turn.
Forbidden Pact alone supplies the cantrip, not a rank 2 spell repertoire orRPpool for that copied release.
A perceived attack spell directed at you from 60 ft may qualify through the targeted clause despite the ordinary 30 ftwitness radius.
Observing a monster restore RP cannot produce a copied recovery profile.

completePriorImplementationCases.scope: Ten complete source-linked integration obligations for future Codex engine work. These are NOT runtime-passed tests. Isolated narrower model tests are reported separately.

cases.kind: Existing complete numeric fixture plus selected causality
cases.given: Use the entire preserved EN6-05-A actor, geometry, admission and entry28/exit24 fixture. Root is created once on actual admission.
events: admit prison and snapshot original caster Null flag
cases.expected: 100→72→48HP; two damage events under one original-caster root. No single event reaches50. Duplicate ending/cleanup callbacks yield no third packet.

cases.given: Actually admitted prison with a recorded creation flag; provide a separately lawful source event that changes caster Null state after admission. This fixture does not supply that source event.
cases.expected: Exit retains the stored flag, independent of current Veil. Current recipient defenses are evaluated separately. Test both creationFlag=false/current=true and creationFlag=true/current=false.

cases.given: Same caster actually maintains the old prison and legally commits a replacement concentration spell. Any counter/save provider must be genuinely legal.
events: new legal commitment displaces old concentration
old unsuppressed live exit resolves once
new counter/save result prevents new admission
cases.expected: Old application stays ended; no refund/restoration, no new entry/root. Compare a different caster saved-against attempt, which leaves old prison intact because it never reached replacement-by-admission.

cases.given: New failed-save otherwise eligible prison would replace another caster's old prison. Supply the actual old-exit damage/life response path, not an assumed zeroHP death.
events: old exit and real responses finish
revalidate same recipient and new cast concentration/source
admit new only if still eligible
cases.expected: Actual death/removal or new-source cancellation prevents new entry/root. Alive at0HP alone does not. No new save/target choice or payment refund.

cases.given: Use the full EN6-03-B fixture, preserving the separately unresolved prior grapple contest. Ready release2.2; underwayphaseEND2.4; futureSTART8/END8.4; expiry14.4. Independent suppression coversSTART8 and ends8.3.
cases.expected: One early STR save at8.4 despite no travel/instruction. No early save2.4; no final save14.4; no phase invented if chassis supplies none.

cases.given: A meaningful Geas was admitted only as soft movement/ordinary interaction. An actual later obstacle would require a full Action.
events: seek valid safe soft method or wait
actual voluntary action by target may independently open a path
cases.expected: No new compelled whole Action, hard reservation or objective. Preserve deadline and legitimate temporary suspension. Voluntary action not granted or compelled by Geas.

cases.given: An actual documentedCR<=10 admitted target really uses an owner-attached chassis. The pending EN5-01-A/B creature profiles do not themselves prove this given.
cases.expected: UnderwayEND WIS save but no retroactive START order; future orders preserve original-owner shared caps. Absence supplies END-only saves with saved cadence anchor, no actions. Mapping/repeatedcallbacks do not duplicate or reset saves/deadline.

cases.given: A real acquired Action-time Control15 source can legally be readied. Mode/preparation-bound choices and all source component/comprehension timing must be supplied by its actual rules.
cases.expected: Use release-time legal targets/orderedlist/area and actualresolution snapshots. No setup ghost target, secondRP/component/counter/cadence, free speech or retroactive hearing. Field/control lifetime starts at actual establishment.

cases.given: Actually authorized feat-copy preparation in numberedroundN with Ready still live before nextownregularSTART in N+1. Actual classsharedengine exists only if separately acquired.
cases.expected: UseNandN+1cap(s), not twoRPpayments or two permissionuses/counterwindows/historyupdates. Same-round release reuses only thisholdtokens. Later capfailure has no partial spend; expires at originaldeadline.

cases.given: Another copy/class release before the priorholdexpiry needs its own independently lawful Action/Reaction/source opportunity; this fixture grants none.
cases.expected: Priorhold grants no priority and cannot bypass spentcurrentcap. No reaction/partialotherledger debit on blockedattempt; no cap/permissionrefund from losthold. Save/load and retryIDs preservechronology.

cases.given: Actually authorized feat-copy preparation in numberedroundN with Ready still live before nextownregularSTART in N+1. Actual classsharedengine exists only if separately acquired.
events: atomically commit preparation allowance(s), actual Action/costs/permission/history in N
actual perceivable trigger completes in N+1 before every original deadline
validate same paid hold receipts, real Reaction, concentration and actual current target/source predicates; do not check N+1 copy allowances
atomically consume hold once and actual Reaction; no new copy/class allowance
cases.expected: Only preparation-round N allowance(s) are spent by this hold. A free N+1 allowance remains free; an independently already-spent N+1 allowance remains spent with its own original owner/use identity and does not block this hold. RP/components/permission/counter/history occur once. Same-round release also spends no new allowance. Invalid release has no new debit; expiry is unchanged and wins at its exact marker.
cases.policySupersession: The former both-touched-round outcome is superseded only for this copy-Ready accounting decision. Complete original case retained in baseline/IMPLEMENTATION_CASES_RECONCILED.json and the unchanged corrections01 archive.

cases.given: Another copy/class release before the priorholdexpiry needs its own independently lawful Action/Reaction/source opportunity; this fixture grants none.
events: prior-round paid hold is still valid before its next-own-regular-START/earlier source deadline
a separately source-qualified nonconcentration competing direct copy or class use consumes its own current-round allowance with a genuine action opportunity
the old hold trigger completes while concentration and real Reaction remain available
validate and commit the old release independently of the already-spent current allowance
compare reverse ordering: old release first leaves current allowance available for another genuinely legal commitment
cases.expected: Both lawful uses may resolve in the same numbered release round. The held release never recharges, overwrites or bypasses the competing use's own commitment rule; it simply is not a new commitment. No Action opportunity, Reaction, capture or second concentration slot is supplied by this case. A competing concentration-breaking cast ends the hold under its actual rule. A missing legal action opportunity leaves the competing-use branch conditional, not a free additional cast. Failed/declined release spends no Reaction; preparation is never refunded.
cases.policySupersession: The former both-touched-round outcome is superseded only for this copy-Ready accounting decision. Complete original case retained in baseline/IMPLEMENTATION_CASES_RECONCILED.json and the unchanged corrections01 archive.
